def test_all_prefixes():
    # Empty string
    assert all_prefixes("") == []

    # Single character
    assert all_prefixes("a") == ["a"]

    # Typical case
    assert all_prefixes("abc") == ["a", "ab", "abc"]

    # String with spaces
    assert all_prefixes("hi!") == ["h", "hi", "hi!"]

    # Longer string
    assert all_prefixes("abcd") == ["a", "ab", "abc", "abcd"]

    # Verify count matches length
    s = "hello"
    assert len(all_prefixes(s)) == len(s)

    # Verify each prefix is a prefix of the original
    for p in all_prefixes("world"):
        assert "world".startswith(p)

    print("All tests passed!")
